name: io.github.Keel-Official/keel-mcp
title: Keel
description: Read-only liquidity risk for Stellar assets: executable depth, safe collateral size, risk bands.

environmentVariables.name: KEEL_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Keel API base URL. Defaults to the public API.

environmentVariables.name: KEEL_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Per request timeout in milliseconds, for the Keel API and for each Soroban RPC step of audit_blend_pool.

environmentVariables.name: KEEL_CACHE_TTL_MS
environmentVariables.description: Cache lifetime in milliseconds for the asset list and the methodology.

environmentVariables.name: KEEL_SOROBAN_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Soroban RPC used by audit_blend_pool to read Blend pools from Stellar mainnet.
